purpose: Current competitor and primary-rule research supporting the Growth + Operations + Compliance story and compliance delta.

marketSignals.observation: Clio Grow presents intake/CRM, automation, reputation and marketing-source reporting as a connected growth workflow.
Clio Manage presents cases, clients, billing, documents, communication and firm operations in one practice-management platform.
Lawmatics presents legal CRM, client intake and marketing automation as one growth platform.
MyCase connects intake/lead management to broader law-firm operational workflows.

primaryComplianceSources.observation: Model Rule 7.1 prohibits false or misleading communications about lawyer services.

New York replaced Rules 7.1 and 7.3 effective June 1, 2026; current Rule 7.1 includes truthfulness, specialist-certification conditions and responsible-lawyer/firm contact information; Rule 7.3 defines and restricts solicitation.

productPositioningInference: Competitors commonly connect growth or operations. Smarter Justice should tell its accepted product story as Growth + Operations + Compliance under one roof, while making capability state and jurisdictional limitations explicit.
